Plot GGB regression

Source: R/ggb.R
plot_ggb.Rd

Return ggplot2 object with plot for GGB regression using outputs from ggb function.

Usage

plot_ggb(results, id_cols_subset)

Arguments

results

[list(2)]
Output from ggb function

id_cols_subset

[list()]
Named list where names are id_cols and each entry has the value(s) of the ID columns to be plotted. Ex: id_cols_subset = list(location = "South Africa", sex = "male", age_start = seq(5, 80, 5)).

Value

ggplot2 plot object to display the GGB regression inputs and linear fit.
